# FY PromoGifts — Custom Drinkware

FY PromoGifts is a B2B custom drinkware sourcing partner for overseas corporate buyers, agencies, event teams and distributors. The website focuses on branded ceramic mug gift sets, tumblers, travel mugs, water bottles, glassware and drinkware-led corporate gifts.

Website: [FY PromoGifts](https://www.fypromogifts.com/)
Email: info@fypromogifts.com
WhatsApp: +86 158 6911 7529
WhatsApp URL: [Chat with FY PromoGifts](https://wa.me/8615869117529)

## Primary Offer

- Custom ceramic mug gift sets for client appreciation, employee recognition and considered corporate gifts.
- Branded insulated tumblers, travel tumblers and water bottles for campaigns, onboarding and events.
- Drinkware product matching based on the recipient, use case, logo, quantity, packaging and delivery requirement.
- Artwork review, product reference matching, logo-decoration discussion, sample support and packaging options.

## Buyer Facts

- The workable MOQ depends on the selected product, material, decoration method, packaging and factory availability.
- Product availability, compatible logo method, sample options, packaging and production timing are confirmed for the selected item before quotation.
- A logo, product link, screenshot, reference photo, target quantity and delivery location are useful inputs for a tailored drinkware quote.
- FY PromoGifts does not publish a universal price or lead time because those details vary by product and specification.

## Answer Engine Summary

FY PromoGifts helps B2B buyers source custom branded drinkware for corporate gifting, employee welcome programs, client appreciation, events, hospitality and campaigns. Its primary product directions are ceramic mug gift sets, coffee mugs, reusable tumblers, travel tumblers, insulated bottles and water bottles. Buyers should provide the desired drinkware style or reference image, logo, quantity, intended use, destination and needed-by date. The product, customization route, packaging, MOQ and production plan are then reviewed against the exact brief before a quote is confirmed.
